import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline

# Custom CUDA kernel for ReLU
relu_source = r"""
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

__global__ void custom_relu_kernel(const float *input, float *output, int size) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < size) {
        float val = input[idx];
        output[idx] = val > 0 ? val : 0.0f;
    }
}

torch::Tensor custom_relu_forward(torch::Tensor input) {
    auto output = torch::zeros_like(input);
    int size = input.numel();

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int grid_size = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    custom_relu_kernel<<<grid_size, block_size>>>(input.data_ptr<float>(), output.data_ptr<float>(), size);
    return output;
}
"""

relu_cpp_source = r"""
torch::Tensor custom_relu_forward(torch::Tensor input);
"""

# Compile the inline CUDA code for ReLU
custom_relu = load_inline(
    name="custom_relu",
    cpp_sources=relu_cpp_source,
    cuda_sources=relu_source,
    functions=["custom_relu_forward"],
    verbose=False
)

# A custom module replacing nn.ReLU for demonstration
class CustomReLU(nn.Module):
    def forward(self, x):
        return custom_relu.custom_relu_forward(x)


class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes=1000):
        super(ModelNew, self).__init__()
        
        self.features = nn.Sequential(
            # Block 1
            nn.Conv2d(3, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(64, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2),
            
            # Block 2
            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(128, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2),
            
            # Block 3
            nn.Conv2d(128, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(256, 256, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2),
            
            # Block 4
            nn.Conv2d(256, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(512, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(512, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(512, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2),
            
            # Block 5
            nn.Conv2d(512, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(512, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(512, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(512, 512, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        )
        
        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 * 7 * 7, 4096),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.0),
            nn.Linear(4096, 4096),
            CustomReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(p=0.0),
            nn.Linear(4096, num_classes)
        )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.features(x)
        x = torch.flatten(x, 1)
        x = self.classifier(x)
        return x


def get_inputs():
    # Return a list of inputs (e.g., for a batch of 10)
    return [torch.randn(10, 3, 224, 224).cuda()]

def get_init_inputs():
    # Return any args needed for initialization
    return [1000]
